title: Critical Bug Fixes — Multi-Start Threading, Facing, MillTurn, Routing
brief: Fix all CRITICAL severity bugs found during 14 scrutinization passes. Each fix gets a regression test.

units.title: Fix multi-start threading — generate N G76 blocks
units.description: TurningPrintToProgramEngine threading section generates only 1 G76 regardless of thread_starts. Fix: generate N G76 blocks with Q offset by 360/starts degrees. Create regression test.

units.title: Fix facing — implement G72 multi-pass or loop
units.description: Face operation does single-pass G01 X-1.0. Fix: implement G72 facing cycle or multi-pass G01 loop with DOC from physics.

units.title: Fix MillTurn assembleProgram() crash
units.description: MillTurnSwissPipelineEngine dispatches to assembleProgram() which doesn't exist. Implement full multi-channel G-code assembly with sync codes for 6 controller dialects.

units.title: Fix routing — action names + method names
units.description: MultiProcessCAMBridge uses wrong action name 'turning_program' (should be 'turning_print_to_program'). QuoteToShip uses .generate/.run (should be .calculate). Fix all mismatches. Test each route.

units.title: Fix Kienzle approach angle in turning
units.description: TurningPrintToProgram passes ap directly as chip width. Correct: b=ap/sin(κr), h=f×sin(κr). Add approach angle from insert geometry.
exit_conditions: VNMG at 35° gives different force than CNMG at 95°

units.title: Fix robustness_weight=0 in OptimalStrategySelection
units.description: WEIGHT_PROFILES all set robustness:0.00. Engagement control has zero influence on strategy scoring. Set to 0.15 for balanced, higher for tool_life priority.

units.title: Fix grooving G75 Q parameter
units.description: G75 Q is set to groove_width×1000 but Q should be insert_width minus overlap for multi-plunge. Fix Q calculation.
exit_conditions: Wide groove generates correct Q for multi-plunge
